title: Lanework card
description: A card's `index.md` — depth 2 inside a board, and the level whose body is the whole point.

schema.description: Always 1. Below the board root a missing value reads as 1.

title.description: The card's display name. Quote a value containing a colon.

kind.description: `card`. Written at creation; the only discriminator inside `.trash/`.

created.description: When the card was filed, and by whom.

modified.description: The last app write that rewrote this file's content.

icon.description: The card's SF Symbol and the tint it wears.

order.description: Rank within the lane, ascending top-to-bottom. Missing or unusable reads as append-at-end.

labels.description: The card's labels — a list of self-sufficient label maps. One reading, projected to a flat list of default-kind names where a surface wants one.

due.description: The card's due date, read through the same grammar the stamps take. A value naming no time of day is a floating calendar day.

priority.description: The card's one priority, as a whole label: `{text, rank, color, icon}`, the kind implied by the key so the value stamps none.

component.description: The card's one component, as a whole label. Open by default, so it normally carries `text` plus the kind's own colour.

hero.description: The uuid of one of this card's own attachments, drawn as a banner. An identity, never a path: a value carrying `/` has no reading.

waiting.description: The card is blocked on a human's reply: `{on, since, comment}`. Set by an agent, removed by the app once a human has commented on the card later than `since`.

remote.description: The one tracker ticket this card mirrors, self-contained. Absent means not yet published to the bound tracker.

start.description: Proposed, unruled — not read by this build. A start date, `due`'s own grammar.

end.description: Proposed, unruled — not read by this build. An end date, `due`'s own grammar.

related.description: Proposed, unruled — not read by this build. A list of related card identities.

depends-on.description: Proposed, unruled — not read by this build. A list of card identities this card depends on.

iconColor.description: Retired: folded into `icon.color` on the next icon-touching write. The mapping wins per property.

modified-by.description: Retired: folds into `modified.by`. The map wins where both are present.

author.description: Retired: folds into `created.by` as `{name: …}` by a scheduled heal at every level.

deleted.description: Retired: the tombstone model. Deletion is a move into `.trash/`; a present key relocates the item.
